sentences.en: The president instructed the employees to improve their productivity.
sentences.zh: 总统指示员工提高他们的生产率。

sentences.en: Productivity has fallen. Accordingly, workers' bonuses will be reduced.
sentences.zh: 生产率下降了。因此，工人的奖金将被削减。

sentences.en: A flexible work schedule increases the productivity of employees.
sentences.zh: 灵活的工作时间表提高了员工的生产率。

senses.zh: 生产率，生产力,经济学 生产率,生态学生产率
